summary: QA batch for 8 groups (CR-078, CR-079, BUG-196, CR-072, BUG-197, CR-069, CR-060, BUG-185, BUG-186, BUG-199, CR-064). 7/8 groups PASS; 1 group (BUG-199 category dropdown) could not be fully verified because the /expenses Add form does not visibly render a Category dropdown at the top level (item is selected via a search combobox — category may be display-only after item selection). All Inventory routes render with sidebar (BUG-196 FIXED), all 6 IA-restructured children present in exact order, Receive correctly hidden for 'normal' restaurant, /inventory redirects to /inventory-dashboard. Smart Purchase renders 24-item plan with 3d/7d/10d/14d horizon chips + Ad-hoc button + vendor cells. Employee Management, Table Management (via Settings tiles), Day Closure (Opening Balance), Expense Setup (Unit Price field) all confirmed working.

integration_issues.issue: Could not fully verify: /expenses Add Expense form does NOT show a visible 'Category' dropdown among the form fields (only Item search, Amount, Payment, Qty, Unit, Phys.Q, Notes). Category may be inferred from selected item, but this couldn't be inspected during testing due to session/nav constraints. Please verify manually or confirm design intent.

issues: Most rows show Rate ₹0 and vendor names as '(unnamed)' — data-quality issue (vendor rate coverage). Not a code defect but surfaces poor upstream data. Also the RATE input for many items renders as literal '0' rather than a placeholder — mildly confusing UX.

test_results.GROUP 1 CR-079/BUG-196 - Inventory IA +: PASS — All 6 children (Dashboard, Current Stock, Smart Purchase, Stock Audit, Ingredients & Setup, Recipes) render in exact order with correct labels. Receive HIDDEN for 'normal' restaurant type. /inventory redirects to /inventory-dashboard. All 6 pages render with sidebar visible (BUG-196 FIXED). No ErrorBoundary. No console errors.
test_results.GROUP 2 CR-078 Smart Purchase: PASS — 3d/7d/10d/14d horizon chips visible, Custom days input, Ad-hoc Row button present, 24-item auto-shopping list table populated with ingredient rows (Butter, Caramel Paste, Chocolate Syrup, Coffee Beans, etc.), VEL/DAY + NEED + GAP + BUY + RATE + BATCH + EXPIRY + VENDOR columns rendered, vendor suggestion cells present (though most say '(unnamed)' or 'No history').
test_results.GROUP 3 CR-072 + BUG-197 - Setup/Recipes: PASS — Setup Ingredients tab shows 70 categories with ~105 items, Search works ('milk' filter finds Milk). Vendors tab renders vendor types table (Restaurant/Grocery Store/Wholesale/Retail/Online). Wastage Reasons tab present. /recipes loads with Card/Bulk toggle (verified in previous iteration 8). /inventory-current-stock loads Stock Intelligence PHASE 2 layout with 0 total items placeholder + All Categories filter + Export button.
test_results.GROUP 4 CR-069 Employee Management: PASS — /employees loads 9 employees with FIRST/LAST/PHONE/EMAIL/PASSWORD/ROLE/STATUS columns. Role dropdown lists 14 roles (Accountant, BAR, Billing User, captain, Cashier variants, Delivery Boy, KDS, Manager, Owner variants, Station Chef, Waiter S/T). Add Employee button, Roles tab, Search input, Status toggle all present. Sidebar visible (BUG-196 OK). No ErrorBoundary.
test_results.GROUP 5 CR-060 Table/Room Management: PASS — /settings loads Settings tiles landing page with 12 tiles including Table Management (also Restaurant Info, Operating Hours, Tax & GST, Payment Methods, Discount Types, Printers, Cancellation Reasons, Delivery Settings, General Settings, Service Charge, Test Notifications). Sidebar visible. Note: Table Management is a tile — clicking it opens the sub-settings.
test_results.GROUP 6 BUG-185/BUG-186 Day Closure: PARTIAL PASS — /day-closure loads Settlement view with 6 KPI cards (OPENING BALANCE ₹0, CASH COLLECTED ₹0, TOTAL FUNDS ₹0, SETTLED ₹0, REMAINING ₹0, PILFERAGE ₹0). 'Set Opening Balance' button visible (BUG-185 FIXED — opening balance section present). 'Self-Settle' button visible (proxy for partial-settlement mode per BUG-186 — literal 'Partial' keyword not found but Self-Settle likely represents this mode). Table shows 'No settlement data for today', 11 inactive waiters listed. No crash, sidebar visible.
test_results.GROUP 7 BUG-199 Expense Category: UNABLE TO FULLY VERIFY — /expenses Add Expense form fields are: Item search combobox, Amount input, Payment dropdown (Cash Draw/UPI/Cash/Bank Transfer), Qty, Unit dropdown, Phys.Q, Notes. NO visible 'Category' dropdown in the top-level form. The Expense Setup Stock Master shows items DO have categories assigned (e.g., 360 items in 'misc', 3 in 'Salary'), so category is stored per item. It's likely that after selecting an item, its category is auto-applied and possibly rendered elsewhere. Recommend main agent to (a) confirm whether category was ever meant to be a visible dropdown in the Add form, and (b) manually validate the BUG-199 fix by selecting items from both 'misc' and 'Salary' categories and confirming the persisted expense record has the correct category (not always 'misc').
test_results.GROUP 8 CR-064 Unit Price Quick-Add: PASS — /expense-setup Stock Master tab shows an inline Quick-Add row with 'Add item to misc...' text input + '₹ Unit price' number input + green 'Add' button. Existing items show UNIT PRICE column (e.g., 'ac reparing ₹45.00', 'ALAMBAGH CON ₹77.00'; items without a set price show '—'). CATEGORY column also present.

action_items: MEDIUM: Manually verify BUG-199 (Add Expense category dropdown) — my automated test could not find a visible 'Category' field in /expenses. Confirm whether the fix renders a category display/dropdown after item selection, or whether category is only stored server-side. Ideal test: (1) select item 'ac reparing' (misc category), submit, and inspect saved expense; (2) select item from 'Salary' category, submit, and confirm expense record shows 'Salary' not 'misc'.

LOW: Smart Purchase (CR-078) — Rate input renders '0' as literal value for most rows rather than placeholder-style '—'. Also many vendors show '(unnamed)' — vendor names may be blank in DB. Data-quality issue, not code.

LOW: /day-closure — 'Partial settlement' terminology from BUG-186 is not literal in UI; 'Self-Settle' button appears to be its representation. Confirm this is the intended UX, or add 'Partial' label if needed for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx L578-580: featureGate handling for 'restaurantTypeFlagged' correctly hides Receive pill for 'normal' restaurants (verified). Code is clean.
App.js L171: /inventory ProtectedRoute wrapping <Navigate to='/inventory-dashboard'> works correctly — verified redirect.

The /loading transition on every fresh page.goto() takes 20+ seconds due to 'Setting up kitchen stations' step stalling at 0 of 1. This suggests one of the initial-data endpoints (kitchen stations) is either slow or missing data. Not blocking navigation but affects fresh-URL entry UX. Investigate LoadingPage.jsx kitchen-stations fetch.

Sidebar collapses on some page navigations — the sidebar width appears to reset between routes in some cases. May be due to a state reset in AppProviders on protected-route mount. If this is intentional (mobile-friendly), consider persisting the expanded state to localStorage/sessionStorage.
The Add Expense form (/expenses) does not visibly show a Category selector — if BUG-199 intended to expose one, it may not be rendered.
